description: Project Astro uses NASA data and interactive Mars maps to analyze landing sites, terrain hazards, and surface conditions. It helps mission planners assess risks, identify safer landing zones, and plan efficient rover routes for future Mars exploration.
summary:
PROJECT ASTRO - Guide to Survival on Mars

A fun way to navigate around Mars and plan a mission.

Interactive Mars map, landing suitability tool, site comparison, terrain hazard analysis, Mars weather guide, water and resource investigation tool, rover path planner, crew survival calculator and mission reporter.

Easily navigate around the complicated mission planning problems. This provides you with tools to help you identify the best areas to explore on Mars, compare landing sites, analyse terrain hazards, calculate the distance travelled by your rover and estimate the survival requirements for your crew.

All of this helps make Planetary Science more accessible. This can be used within education, scientific discovery and research into planning future missions to Mars.

Explore Mars. Plan Smart. Be Prepared.
details:
Project Astro - Martian Map

An interactive web-based tool that makes exploring Mars easier to understand. It also helps with researching the planets for educational purposes so we can gain knowledge about future missions both manned and unmanned.

What does the project do?

This tool provides a central place to use many of the different tools required to plan out a mission. The user can view an interactive map of Mars, view coordinates, identify possible landing zones, compare landing sites, see any hazards on the surface, discover potential resources and plan a route for your rovers. It also calculates the distance you would need to travel and estimates what resources are needed for the crew to survive.

Main features:

Martian Explorer: Interactive map of Mars, view coordinates and save locations.

Landing Zone Analyser: Calculates whether a landing zone is suitable using factors such as slope, height, amount of rocks and temperature.

Landing Site Comparer: Used to compare possible landing sites.

Hazard Detector: Shows any hazards seen on the terrain, manage the data and filter by proximity.

Weather & Environment: Shows historical weather data from NASA’s Insight such as temperature, pressure and wind speed.

Water & Resources: Information on possible resources on mars and helps to plan resources.

Rover Route Planner: Create waypoints, calculate approximate surface distances and potential hazards.

Survival Planner: Calculate how much water, food, oxygen and power will be needed depending on the number of crew, length of mission and consumption rate.

Mission Reports: All available mission planning information can be found here.
